# Daniel Sees an Everlasting Kingdom Story Path

**Lesson:** K4-L12 - Daniel Sees an Everlasting Kingdom

## Purpose

Support the primary activity for Daniel Sees an Everlasting Kingdom.

## Instructions

1. Read the principal passage.
2. Record direct observations.
3. Separate interpretation from application.
4. Name one faithful response.

## Text

Daniel 2:31-45; 7:13-14

## Big idea

God's kingdom will outlast every human empire.

## Guardrails

Treat Daniel's symbolic visions as apocalyptic imagery; avoid speculative charts or date-setting. | Do not equate any current nation or party straightforwardly with Daniel's kingdoms without evidence.
